description: List a website's chart annotations, newest first, with their source: databuddy when people added them, or read-only GitHub markers (github_deployment, github_release) for successful production deploys and published releases, with links. github says how far markers reach. from, to and sources narrow the list.

from.description: Only annotations reaching this YYYY-MM-DD date (UTC) or ISO datetime.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

sources.description: Only these sources: databuddy, github_deployment, github_release.

to.description: Only annotations starting by this YYYY-MM-DD date (UTC) or ISO datetime.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: list_annotations

outputSchema.description: annotations contains chart marks with IDs, type, text, coordinates, tags, color, visibility, source, GitHub link and update time. total counts annotations; hasMore indicates another page.

title: List annotations
